summary: Third pass of the fuller enumeration (layer 3). Chapter 4 (Department of Defense) and chapter 5 (Department of Homeland Security) were read in full and every concrete, checkable recommendation was matched against the existing records. Twenty-four further recommendations were researched, independently reviewed and scored blind for significance by two AI raters: 12 from chapter 4 (one of them the war powers recommendation on page 88 of the Section Two introduction) and 12 from chapter 5. No candidate was dropped in review as a duplicate; partial overlaps are recorded as cross-references. Review changed four ratings: c04-13 from in progress to no action found, and lower progress scores for c04-19, c04-20 and c05-21. Review also corrected the paraphrase of the document text in c04-21, c05-16 and c05-19, and those records were rescored for significance on the corrected text. The new records are held off the page and out of the headline counts until the fuller enumeration is shown as a separate figure; they are included in the public data file. Stages as added: c04-12 not_started 0; c04-13 not_started 0; c04-14 in_progress 40; c04-15 implemented 75; c04-16 in_progress 40; c04-17 in_progress 30; c04-18 in_progress 30; c04-19 in_progress 45; c04-20 in_progress 35; c04-21 diverged 0; c04-22 implemented 90; c04-23 diverged 0; c05-13 in_progress 55; c05-14 in_progress 30; c05-15 in_progress 30; c05-16 implemented 85; c05-17 in_progress 25; c05-18 in_progress 50; c05-19 blocked 40; c05-20 diverged 0; c05-21 in_progress 45; c05-22 blocked 10; c05-23 proposed 15; c05-24 in_progress 25.
